limitations.note: The rewrite preserved behavior for known inputs but changed four-state simulation behavior: at a word boundary, an unknown `valid_in` now forces `valid_out` low instead of propagating the unknown as the minimal fix would.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the tool to reject the entire invocation before Icarus Verilog could run.
The testbench left `valid_in` high when releasing the midstream reset, so the DUT accepted an input the scoreboard did not count and the test had to be rerun.
